tables.name: persons
tables.purpose: Stable person identity; consolidation never rewrites original event actors

tables.name: person_identity_versions
tables.purpose: Attributed identity corrections; issued CTM references stay frozen
constraints: CHECK(gender IS NULL OR gender IN ('M','F'))

tables.name: accounts
tables.purpose: Provider-only account; no usable local password credential

tables.name: account_identities
tables.purpose: Bind validated issuer and subject, never email-only role inference

tables.name: account_email_versions
tables.purpose: Verified contact history; changing email does not rewrite filings

tables.name: verification_tokens
tables.purpose: Hashed one-use email/invitation token; not password recovery

tables.name: app_sessions
tables.purpose: Server sessions; no application inactivity logout; revocation remains enforceable

tables.name: tribunals
tables.purpose: One operating tribunal, not a new multi-tenant product

tables.name: staff_memberships
tables.purpose: Explicit admin-authorized council enrollment
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX staff_current_account ON staff_memberships(account_id) WHERE active_until IS NULL

tables.name: staff_roles
tables.purpose: Effective role grants; only existing admin creates council membership
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX role_current ON staff_roles(membership_id,role) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL

tables.name: account_events
tables.purpose: Status changes, role changes, identity linking and authentication events

tables.name: identity_consolidations
tables.purpose: Verified primary account and canonical person; retained duplicate histories

tables.name: identity_review_holds
tables.purpose: Exact duplicate-person review blocks payment/submission, not draft saves

tables.name: ctm_applicants
tables.purpose: CTM identity independent of account and case reference

tables.name: dioceses
tables.purpose: Optional directory; submitted text assertions remain original

tables.name: parishes
tables.purpose: Optional parish reference; no forced normalization of submitted spelling

tables.name: marriages
tables.purpose: Matching registry separate from both parties attributed assertions
constraints: CHECK(spouse_birth_date_low IS NULL OR spouse_birth_date_high IS NULL OR spouse_birth_date_low<=spouse_birth_date_high)

tables.name: cases
tables.purpose: Shared permanent case with original number and separate proceedings

tables.name: case_identifiers
tables.purpose: Original, canonical and alias identifiers; never reused or renumbered
constraints: CHECK(daily_sequence IS NULL OR daily_sequence BETWEEN 1 AND 99)
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX allocated_case_number ON case_identifiers(reference) WHERE namespace='ctm'
UNIQUE INDEX primary_case_number ON case_identifiers(case_id) WHERE is_primary

tables.name: case_number_counters
tables.purpose: Atomic Los Angeles daily sequence allocation

tables.name: case_parties
tables.purpose: Known spouse and participating applicant are different states
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX case_known_person ON case_parties(case_id,person_id) WHERE person_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: applicant_references
tables.purpose: Frozen case-based or historical applicant reference, never an access key

tables.name: person_open_case_claims
tables.purpose: One open case per canonical participating person; includes historical cases

tables.name: person_active_draft_claims
tables.purpose: One new-case draft; mutually exclusive with different open case claim

tables.name: case_proceedings
tables.purpose: Closed original proceedings never unlock; accepted appeal creates new section
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX one_open_proceeding ON case_proceedings(case_id) WHERE status='open'
UNIQUE INDEX appeal_decree_sequence_unique ON case_proceedings(case_id,appeal_decree_sequence) WHERE appeal_decree_sequence IS NOT NULL

tables.name: case_lifecycle_events
tables.purpose: Opening, closure, reopening, retained association and historical correction history

tables.name: case_association_events
tables.purpose: Preserved matching evidence, original case aliases and wrong-association corrections

tables.name: case_party_onboarding
tables.purpose: Pending intended email; activate only on matching verified registration

tables.name: registration_invitation_events
tables.purpose: Staff-initiated invitation email only; not an automatic enrollment side effect

tables.name: case_assignments
tables.purpose: President-authorized single current case manager; separate entering actor
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX one_case_manager ON case_assignments(case_id) WHERE ends_at IS NULL

tables.name: historical_entry_workspaces
tables.purpose: Private admin historical entry staging; no fee or fabricated required facts

tables.name: questionnaires
tables.purpose: Versioned applicant/appeal form identity

tables.name: questionnaire_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable published form; exact version retained on submission

tables.name: declaration_versions
tables.purpose: Exact bilingual declaration or medical-release wording

tables.name: applications
tables.purpose: Private draft, independent filing owner, same application on return/resubmission

tables.name: application_revisions
tables.purpose: Immutable committed snapshot; frozen revision at payment/submission

tables.name: application_person_assertions
tables.purpose: Self/spouse facts, explicit missing-value states, no shared overwrite
constraints: CHECK(gender IS NULL OR gender IN ('M','F'))

tables.name: application_marriage_assertions
tables.purpose: Exact source marriage/date/certificate assertion and prior religious affiliation

tables.name: application_separation_assertions
tables.purpose: Attributed separation/civil-divorce/counseling assertions

tables.name: application_repeat_entries
tables.purpose: Stable collection row identity across application revisions

tables.name: application_children
tables.purpose: Child name, DOB, gender and lives-with; Unknown allowed where approved

tables.name: application_restraining_orders
tables.purpose: Multiple reported orders; each requires court, case number, status and copy

tables.name: application_prior_records
tables.purpose: Separate previous marriages, prior tribunal applications and priest-name entries

tables.name: application_answers
tables.purpose: Other versioned semantic fields; one editable binding per field
indexes: UNIQUE INDEX application_scalar_answer ON application_answers(revision_id,question_code) WHERE entry_id IS NULL
UNIQUE INDEX application_collection_answer ON application_answers(revision_id,question_code,entry_id) WHERE entry_id IS NOT NULL

tables.name: ground_definitions
tables.purpose: Six approved grounds with versioned bilingual labels

tables.name: application_selected_grounds
tables.purpose: Multiple grounds; never council findings

tables.name: application_answer_changes
tables.purpose: Field/repeat-entry change, actual actor/time; no reason or re-sign required

tables.name: filing_candidates
tables.purpose: Frozen checkout candidate for idempotent payment-to-submission recovery

tables.name: application_submissions
tables.purpose: Immutable original or resubmission; signed version is never replaced

tables.name: application_completeness_reviews
tables.purpose: Accept/Reject for completeness; Reject returns same filing with instructions
constraints: CHECK(result<>'reject' OR nullif(btrim(correction_instructions),'') IS NOT NULL)

tables.name: draft_schema_migrations
tables.purpose: Applicant drafts update to published form without losing answers; report draft rules differ

tables.name: party_withdrawals
tables.purpose: Own petition withdrawal; admin may act for all; no reason or approval

tables.name: document_categories
tables.purpose: Stable document meaning, editable labels/code; historical names recorded

tables.name: files
tables.purpose: Logical owner and contextual location; no independent message attachment store

tables.name: file_versions
tables.purpose: Private immutable original; opaque key, latest safe default, version history council only

tables.name: file_name_events
tables.purpose: Code rename changes presented filename, never source bytes or original manifest

tables.name: file_context_links
tables.purpose: Correct question/order/request/evidence context, exact version and description

tables.name: submission_file_manifest
tables.purpose: Exact filenames/checksums/versions retained with submitted filing

tables.name: upload_sessions
tables.purpose: Resumable upload with final authorization and technical validation

tables.name: file_technical_events
tables.purpose: Safety/type/size scan separate from council acceptance

tables.name: file_derivatives
tables.purpose: Private OCR, extraction, preview or media derivative; original unchanged

tables.name: file_access_events
tables.purpose: Audited view/download/playback with source permission recheck

tables.name: search_documents
tables.purpose: Rebuildable Meilisearch provenance, no independent authorization

tables.name: fee_obligations
tables.purpose: One USD250 fee per filing; historical exemption/waiver distinct from payment

tables.name: fee_waivers
tables.purpose: Admin/secretary handles outside applicant application

tables.name: payment_attempts
tables.purpose: Provider references only; no card data; browser redirect never proof

tables.name: payment_events
tables.purpose: Verified, deduplicated payment success/reversal/chargeback events

tables.name: payment_allocations
tables.purpose: A successful charge is allocated to exactly one filing obligation

tables.name: refund_events
tables.purpose: Only accidental duplicate refunds; authorization and provider result distinct

tables.name: topic_groups
tables.purpose: Accepted Topic groups; views do not duplicate questions

tables.name: question_categories
tables.purpose: Reusable Question categories, not duplicate Question topic headings

tables.name: report_questions
tables.purpose: Stable accepted question IDs

tables.name: report_question_versions
tables.purpose: Exact main wording, optional contextual prompts and translation versions

tables.name: topic_category_memberships
tables.purpose: Reusable categories across Topic groups

tables.name: category_question_memberships
tables.purpose: Question/category mapping; selected question appears once unless explicit distinct event

tables.name: report_templates
tables.purpose: Shared or personal template identity; personal has owner
constraints: CHECK((scope='personal' AND owner_member_id IS NOT NULL) OR (scope='shared' AND owner_member_id IS NULL))

tables.name: report_template_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable published selection/order; no answers or private case facts in reusable templates

tables.name: template_publication_submissions
tables.purpose: Publish separate shared copy; retain personal original

tables.name: report_requests
tables.purpose: Request first; assigned intake, freeform external priest or professional assessment

tables.name: sent_intake_question_snapshots
tables.purpose: Immutable exact sent questions, not all optional interviewer guidance

tables.name: external_report_links
tables.purpose: External priest request only; direct link expires in30days; hash only

tables.name: external_response_drafts
tables.purpose: Limited request-scoped save/resume; no case browsing

tables.name: reports
tables.purpose: Completed and working reports; follow-up is also an individual report

tables.name: report_revisions
tables.purpose: Original author narrative edits while authorized/open; actual external/applicant response stays distinct

tables.name: report_answers
tables.purpose: Structured or rich text typed answers separate from generated transcript

tables.name: report_source_links
tables.purpose: Exact application/evidence version displayed or confirmed; never silently rewrite source

tables.name: transcript_versions
tables.purpose: Original AI output plus all edits; source/mixed transcript and full English/Arabic

tables.name: transcript_segments

tables.name: evaluation_release_attestations

tables.name: evaluation_release_scopes
tables.purpose: Release scope applied to bytes/OCR/search/context and disclosures

tables.name: evaluation_reports
tables.purpose: Report receipt, authorization and OCR readiness are separate states

tables.name: evaluation_disclosures

tables.name: finding_versions

tables.purpose: Immediate private portal activity/read flag, distinct from email scheduling

tables.purpose: Source/version/prompt/provider provenance, restricted medical egress boundary

tables.name: translation_versions
tables.purpose: Original and reviewed translated text are separate retained versions
